USMLE-style practice · Pharmacology

Which assay is informative

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

A specialist needs to assess enoxaparin exposure in a selected patient with unusual pharmacokinetic concerns. The routine aPTT is near normal despite recent therapeutic dosing. Which assay is more directly informative about LMWH anticoagulant activity?

  1. Anti-factor Xa activity
  2. Bleeding time
  3. Serum fibrinogen alone
  4. International normalized ratio
  5. Platelet aggregation with arachidonic acid
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

Anti-factor Xa activity

Anti-Xa activity can be useful when LMWH monitoring is specifically indicated.

Understanding the options

Anti-factor Xa activity
Anti-Xa activity can be useful when LMWH monitoring is specifically indicated.
Bleeding time
Bleeding time is not a reliable measurement of LMWH concentration.
Serum fibrinogen alone
Fibrinogen is not a direct marker of LMWH exposure.
International normalized ratio
INR is used for vitamin K antagonist monitoring.
Platelet aggregation with arachidonic acid
Arachidonic-acid aggregation assesses platelet cyclooxygenase-related effects.
